note: BH-9177. The bound on bin/selection-gate.sh's `bin/remote-gate.sh --image-id` probe (one flyctl ssh round trip, plus a host wake). Past it the probe is killed and suite reuse is off for that run: every suite runs. It is outside the main run's timeout. bin/lib/selection-gate.sh reads the row; bin/lib/selection-gate-reuse.sh falls back to 60.
